jobs.name: s5_people
jobs.prompt: A small queue of several different customers waiting at a bright modern pharmacy counter: a young mother holding a toddler, an elderly man, a middle-aged woman. Each has a slightly worried, anxious expression. View from behind the counter towards the customers, soft daylight.
jobs.meaning: Каждый день через стол фармацевта проходят десятки людей, и почти каждый приходит с лёгкой тревогой

jobs.name: s5_ic_self
jobs.prompt: icon of one adult person (head and shoulders) with a small worried wavy line above the head

jobs.name: s5_ic_child
jobs.prompt: icon of an adult holding the hand of a small child

jobs.name: s5_ic_close
jobs.prompt: icon of an elderly person with a caring hand resting on their shoulder

jobs.name: s5_eyes
jobs.prompt: A customer walks up to the pharmacy counter and looks for the pharmacist; they make warm eye contact. The pharmacist in a white coat behind the counter smiles welcomingly. Side view, both faces visible, pharmacy shelves softly blurred behind.
jobs.meaning: Первое, что посетитель ищет глазами, когда подходит к столу, — это фармацевт

jobs.name: s5_ic_showcase
jobs.prompt: icon of a pharmacy display shelf with a few medicine boxes and bottles

jobs.name: s5_ic_price
jobs.prompt: icon of a price tag with a hole and string, no digits on it

jobs.name: s5_ic_specialist
jobs.prompt: icon of a friendly pharmacist (head and shoulders, white coat, small cross badge) with a small speech bubble
jobs.meaning: живой специалист, который выслушает и поможет

jobs.name: s5_greeting
jobs.prompt: The pharmacist in a white coat behind the counter warmly greets an arriving customer with a genuine smile and a small open-hand welcoming gesture; the customer's tense face softens into a relieved smile. Bright modern pharmacy, soft light.
jobs.meaning: Тёплое приветствие — первый сильный сигнал человеку: «Я вас вижу. Я готов помочь», и напряжение спадает

jobs.name: s5_ic_relief
jobs.prompt: icon of a person's head in profile calmly exhaling, a soft small air puff in front of the mouth, relaxed closed eyes

jobs.name: s5_ic_talk
jobs.prompt: icon of two overlapping speech bubbles, one with three small dots
jobs.meaning: человек начинает рассказывать спокойнее и подробнее
